title: A rota that fills its own gaps
label: Crestview Church AV team
problem: One person built the Sunday AV rota by hand and emailed a spreadsheet around, and every swap meant another round of emails.
built: A shared Google Sheet with Apps Script behind it. It sends the Wednesday and Friday emails, runs the swap, away, check-in, join and training forms, builds draft rotas and keeps everyone's calendar invites in step.
outcome: The 2027 draft went from 19 gaps to 5, with 1,205 automated tests behind it.
